name: IOF
description: IOF TV graphics style (IOF TV Manual for Broadcasters, GFX layout overview): red rank and time boxes, blue headers and footers, uppercase Franklin Gothic, 100 px safe margins, three-layer slide animation. The IOF logo on the race title card and the results and start list headers.
author: Split Control, after the IOF broadcast graphics guidelines
fonts: Libre Franklin (OFL) stands in for ITC Franklin Gothic; install ITC Franklin Gothic Std to use the original.
